name: Vorran Clans
cultural_traditions: Resonance Sculpture — sound-reactive megasculpture that evolves with communal movement
identity_model_note: A people-and-polity: recorded with its cultural traditions as a distinct dimension. The polity is a political structure; the culture is the living tradition; neither reduces to the other.
peoplehood_note: A confederation of clans — a people organized by kinship, not a unitary state. Symmetry-Doctrine allies with the Elari Ascendancy.

cultural_practice.resonance_sculpture: Massive sound-reactive sculptures built into Vorran cities, responding to the movement of passers-by.
cultural_practice.reading: Civic art that requires inhabitants to complete it — the work is silent without people in the street. A populated city sounds different from an empty one.
